'''''Corynephorus canescens''''',  common name '''grey hair-grass'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |access-date=2014-10-17 }}</ref> or '''gray clubawn grass,'''<ref name=PLANTS>{{PLANTS|id=COCA16|taxon=Corynephorus canescens|accessdate=17 January 2016}}</ref> is a species of plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]], native to [[Europe]], the [[Middle East]], and [[North Africa]] but widely naturalized in [[North America]].<ref name=q>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=405825 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref name=kew>{{cite web|url=http://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/imp02559.htm|author=W.D. Clayton |author2=M. Vorontsova |author3=K.T. Harman |author4=H. Williamson|title=Corynephorus canescens|publisher=GrassBase|work=The Board of Trustees, [[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|Royal Botanic Gardens]]|location=[[Kew]]}}</ref><ref name=PLANTS/> In the [[United Kingdom]] it is rare. It can be found at sites such as [[Wangford Warren and Carr]], a [[Site of Special Scientific Interest]] in the [[Breckland]] area of [[Suffolk]].<ref name=sssicite>[http://www.sssi.naturalengland.org.uk/citation/citation_photo/1001871.pdf Wangford Warren and Carr] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140303225759/http://www.sssi.naturalengland.org.uk/citation/citation_photo/1001871.pdf |date=2014-03-03 }}, SSSI citation, [[Natural England]]. Retrieved 2013-03-03.</ref><ref name=sac>[http://jncc.defra.gov.uk/protectedsites/sacselection/sac.asp?EUCode=UK0019865 Breckland], Joint Nature Conservation Committee. Retrieved 2014-03-03.</ref>

==Description==
It has panicles which are {{convert|1.5|–|8|cm}} long and {{convert|0.5|–|1.5|cm}} wide. Its pedicels are {{convert|1|–|3|mm}} in length while the leaf blades are {{convert|2|–|6|cm}} long and {{convert|0.3|–|0.5|mm}} wide. Both the upper and lower [[glumes]] are shiny, [[lanceolate]], and membranous. The [[lemma (botany)|lemma]] have a dorsal [[awn (botany)|awn]] and dentate apex with obscure lateral veins. Its fertile lemma is ovate, keelless, membranous and is {{convert|1.8|–|2.2|mm}} long. The floret [[callus]] is hairy with [[Rachilla (floral axis)|rhachilla]] internodes being pilose. The [[flower]]s have three [[stamen]]s which are {{convert|1.2|–|1.6|mm}} long.<ref name=kew/>
